name: Energy Display
description: A battery-powered tabletop display that shows the power, monthly cost and monthly energy of up to three iMeters, and the room temperature.

verification.note: The Energy Display Developer Notes give each of groups 1 to 3 one meter or modem, which the display reads; they don't say which side of the link the display is.
